scope_note: Weights only. Alpha (alpha_package.json) and Risk (covariance.parquet, risk_package.json) consumed read-only; no re-interpretation. FLOW sleeve sizing + multi-sleeve blend vs STR_1715.
selection_rule: Among walk-forward methods, FIRST filter by turnover hard cap (RT-TO one-way <= 6.0/yr, qvest-opt-style P6 Implementation Discipline). THEN pick max net-of-cost SR among TO-feasible. MVO disqualified at every buffer level (TO 6.38-6.63 > 6.0) despite higher gross net-SR (Cycle 2 lesson: gross sizing edge wiped by binding TO cap). EW hysteresis buffer en=50 = highest net-SR among TO-feasible (5.51/yr PASS).

sleeve_method_comparison._basis: FLOW sleeve walk-forward quarterly rebal, net 15bps one-way, vs KOSPI200, 2005-02..2023-12 (227 mo). RT-TO = one-way annualized turnover (sum one-way / years); hard cap 6.0/yr.

method_log.ew_baseline_comparison: EW_en50 (0.7824) ~ MVO_en50 gross (0.8278) but MVO TO-infeasible. Within TO-feasible set, EW dominates. Confirms DeMiguel-Garlappi-Uppal 2009 1/N out-of-sample robustness for 20-name broad-alpha sleeve; sizing did NOT survive cost+TO discipline.

blend_analysis._basis: Realized monthly net returns. STR_1715 = Charter v1.4 standard monthly basis (str_1715_monthly_returns_full.csv). FLOW = EW_en50 sleeve net monthly. Common overlap window 2008-02..2023-12 (191 mo, lockbox-truncated). Blend = linear combination of two realized streams (standard sleeve operation; PerformanceAnalytics metrics; no self-synthesis of underlying returns).
blend_analysis.returns_correlation_note: High raw returns cor 0.709 (consistent with risk raw cross-book corr 0.776). Dominated by SHARED MARKET BETA (FLOW beta 1.16, STR_1715 beta 1.13). Market-residual cross-corr 0.24 per risk_package -> genuine alpha-level diversification is small-but-real.

sr_2_5_judgment.honest_verdict_AX000: SR 2.5 is NOT reachable with this 2-sleeve blend. Two sleeves of SR ~0.62 and ~0.65 with returns correlation 0.709 are mathematically capped near 0.71 book SR. This is a proven limit (empirical, on realized PIT monthly returns), reported honestly per AX-000 (limit of THESE two return streams' joint distribution, not a method-shopping failure). FLOW DOES add real value (book IR 0.79 -> 1.12, +0.33; SR +0.09; MDD -1.7pp) as a 4th orthogonal-axis diversifier, but the SR 2.5 ambition requires either (a) more low/negatively-correlated sleeves, (b) a market-beta-neutral construction (currently both sleeves beta ~1.15), or (c) re-examination of the SR 1.78 figure's measurement basis (see provenance note).
sr_2_5_judgment.provenance_note: Task cited book SR 1.78 (->2.5). STR_1715 realized-monthly standard SR on this overlap window is 0.617; the 1.78/1.6399 figures are the AR_on_M4_R05 OVERLAY walk-forward measurement basis (book_state STR_1715_AR_on_M4_R05_overlay_PG2), NOT the production-grade realized-monthly basis used for a clean cross-sleeve blend. Blending on consistent realized-monthly basis is the only honest comparison; mixing an overlay-walk-forward SR with a realized-monthly sleeve would be a measurement-coherence violation. Forge should re-blend FLOW with the SAME-basis STR_1715 overlay returns if an overlay-basis book figure is desired.

risk_recommendations_addressed.rec1_combined_momentum_overlap: ADDRESSED (monitor): FLOW & STR_1715 both MOM-loaded (FLOW MOM beta 0.231). Selected 55/45 blend keeps combined active MOM tilt moderate; flagged for Forge/monitoring. Market-residual cross-corr 0.24 is the residual co-exposure measure.

Blend does NOT rely on FLOW for downside beta reduction; diversification is correlation/timing-based (foreign-flight reversal). Book MDD still improves marginally (41.2->39.6%) via timing, not beta.

reports.reason: Book SR 2.5 target unreachable. Max achievable 2-sleeve book SR = 0.707 (FLOW 50%). Two SR~0.62-0.65 sleeves with realized returns correlation 0.709 cannot exceed ~0.71 book SR. Proven empirical limit on PIT realized monthly returns (AX-000 honest report).
reports.suggested_resolution: Add further low/negatively-correlated sleeves (current both beta ~1.15); OR construct market-beta-neutral overlay; OR reconcile the SR 1.78 figure's overlay-walk-forward measurement basis with realized-monthly basis (provenance_note). FLOW is retained as a value-adding 4th diversifier (book IR +0.33), NOT as a path to SR 2.5.

reports.reason: weights.csv schedule density 0.336 < 0.95 mandate. Quarterly cadence (76 as_of dates) is FORCED by the turnover hard cap: alpha_package reports monthly rebal TO = 10.66/yr (FAIL), quarterly = 5.93/yr (PASS). Monthly schedule would violate the 6.0/yr TO cap. This is the documented TO-penalty-forces-skip case -> infeasibility_report mandated (NOT silent skip, Charter section 9).
reports.suggested_resolution: Forge must NOT fabricate intermediate monthly holdings. The 76 quarterly as_of dates ARE the production schedule (FLOW signal is a slow long-horizon flow factor; monthly rebal is economically inappropriate AND TO-infeasible). Density mandate is in tension with TO mandate for this slow-signal sleeve; quarterly cadence is the correct resolution. Forge backtests on the 76-date quarterly schedule as canonical; alpha sig_dates 226 (monthly) are the SIGNAL frequency, not the REBAL frequency.

explanation.method_selected_rationale: Turnover hard cap is the binding constraint. All sizing methods (MVO/HRP/ERC/MinVar/CVaR) fail the 6.0/yr one-way TO cap and are disqualified (no silent relaxation). EW hysteresis buffer (en=50) is the highest net-SR TO-feasible sleeve (5.51/yr). This confirms the broad-alpha 1/N robustness result: the FLOW edge is name SELECTION (band-buffer), not SIZING.
explanation.blend_rationale: STR_1715 55% + FLOW 45% maximizes book IR vs KOSPI200 (1.118). FLOW adds genuine residual diversification despite high raw beta-driven return correlation.
main_tradeoffs: MVO gross net-SR (0.828) higher than EW (0.782) but TO-infeasible -> disqualified.
SR 2.5 unreachable; FLOW value is IR/diversification, not Sharpe-to-2.5.
High raw returns correlation 0.709 (shared market beta) caps book SR; residual diversification (IR) is the realized benefit.
